For the beverage, an effective internal diameter of approximately 7 cm gives an area of **38.5 cm²**. At an estimated liquid depth of 6 cm: 38.5 × 6 ≈ **230 ml**, or **230 g** at 1.0 g/ml. At approximately **20 kcal/100 g**, that contributes **46 kcal**, assuming milk but no added sugar.
